mfa.expired: Verification code expired. Please sign in again.
mfa.invalidCode: Invalid verification code. Please try again.

enrollGate.title: Set up two-factor authentication
enrollGate.intro: Your team's security policy requires every member to enable two-factor authentication before using the system. Scan the QR code below with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Microsoft Authenticator, ...), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
enrollGate.showSecret: Can't scan? Show the key to add it manually
enrollGate.invalidCode: That code is not valid. Enter the code your authenticator shows right now.
enrollGate.backupWarning: These recovery codes are shown only once. If you lose your phone or your authenticator stops working, you can sign in with a recovery code. Each one works a single time. Save them somewhere safe now.
enrollGate.backupAck: I have saved these recovery codes somewhere safe
